label: Slow database
expectation: Rental p99 rises by the injected latency; the gateway breaker stays closed and no 5xx is returned.
observe: Grafana projecty-load-resilience (creation p99, breaker state) and database spans in Tempo.

label: Database down
expectation: Rental endpoints refuse with 503 and Retry-After within the gateway deadline; repeated failures open the breaker and later refusals are immediate.
observe: dependency_refusals_total{dependency="database"}, gateway breaker state, and traces tagged projecty.degradation=database.

label: Redis down
expectation: Rate limiting degrades open; revocation-checked and idempotent mutations refuse closed; ordinary authenticated reads continue.

label: Kafka down
expectation: Rental creation continues. Rental events accumulate in the outbox and drain after Clear; nothing is lost.
observe: projecty_rental_outbox_pending rising then returning to 0, and dependency_degradations_total{dependency="kafka"}.

label: Bad network
expectation: Database responses arrive fragmented and long connections are cut; pooled reconnects and gateway retries keep user-visible errors flat.
observe: k6 error rate, database client spans and gateway retry metrics.

label: Tracking stopped
expectation: The live map freezes with its last marker in place; rentals, listing and the rest of the console continue.
observe: Console Live map (Frozen · reconnecting), telemetry target health in Prometheus, rental creation in Grafana.

label: Cassandra down
expectation: Trip history stops; live positions are still accepted and served from Redis, and rental creation is unaffected.

label: Risk-pricing stopped
expectation: Demand-based pricing stops; rentals are priced on the last published table, and unscored riders pay the base rate.

label: Billing stopped
expectation: The rental screen still lists every rental and says it is shown without invoices; creation and tracking continue.
observe: Console rental list (without invoices) and api-gateway 5xx for /api/invoices in Grafana.
